name: perplexity_research
description: Conduct deep, multi-source research on a topic. Best for: literature reviews, comprehensive overviews, investigative queries needing many sources. Returns a detailed response with numbered citations. Significantly slower than other tools (60+ seconds). For quick factual questions, use perplexity_ask instead. For logical analysis and reasoning, use perplexity_reason instead. Supports optional file attachments via the `files` parameter (requires authentication token).

FileAttachment.description:
A file to attach to the query for document analysis.
Requires authentication tokens. Provide either `text` or `data`, not both.

data.description:
Base64-encoded binary file content. Use for binary files (.pdf, .docx, images).
Mutually exclusive with `text`.

text.description:
Plain-text file content. Use for text files (.txt, .md, .csv, .json, source code).
Mutually exclusive with `data`.

files.description:
Optional file attachments for document analysis.
Requires authentication token (PERPLEXITY_SESSION_TOKEN).
Each entry needs `filename` and either `text` (plain text) or `data` (base64 binary).

query.description: The search query or question to ask.

sources.description:
Information sources to search.
Standard (no auth): "web", "scholar", "social".
Connectors (require auth + connected account): "google_drive",
"gcal" / "google_calendar", "outlook", "notion_mcp" / "notion",
"github_mcp_direct" / "github", "linear_alt" / "linear",
"slack_direct" / "slack", "jira_mcp_merge" / "jira",
"confluence_mcp_merge" / "confluence",
"microsoft_teams_mcp_merge" / "teams", "onedrive", "sharepoint",
"dropbox", "box", "hugging_face" / "huggingface".
Unknown connector IDs are passed through unchanged.
Defaults to ["web"] if not specified.
